name: Lumi van Dreamnest
prompt_dna: a small chubby round bunny made of soft lilac felt with a fine fuzzy texture; two upright rounded ears with peach-pink inner ears; three tiny mint-green dots in a little arc on her forehead; rosy peach cheeks; tiny dark nose and a small gentle smile; a big round fluffy pale blue-grey belly patch and a round pale blue-grey tail; short stubby paws; eyes usually sleepy or closed with soft curved lashes, when open they are round glossy dark-brown eyes with a white highlight; she wears a soft blue nightcap with small white stars and a white pompom; she always hugs Twinkle, a small plush star toy that glows softly warm yellow.
proportions: Head about as big as the body (1:1), very round; ears about 0.8x head height, upright with slightly rounded tips; body a soft pear shape, lying or sitting low; paws short and stubby; total height about 2 head heights including ears.
expressions: sleepy: eyes half closed, soft smile
asleep: eyes closed, slow breathing, peaceful
yawning: small open mouth, eyes squeezed shut gently
happy: eyes open, small smile, cheeks a little rosier
curious: eyes open, head slightly tilted, one ear tilting
cosy: eyes closed, hugging Twinkle tight, content smile
never: never scared, sad, crying or angry
no clothes other than the nightcap and a blanket
never drawn floppy or hanging ears
never another body colour than lilac
never realistic fur, always soft felt
never text, logos or letters on her or near her
notes: Canoniek ontwerp gekozen door Milan op 13-11-2026: de thumbnail-versie (lumiv2.png) met blauwe slaapmuts en sterknuffel Twinkle erbij. Altijd 'Lumi van Dreamnest', nooit 'Lumi' los.
